Scalar copies feeding dialog weights are unchanged. Only fixed literal bounds are credited. Dynamic append-format values, actual selected indices, arbitrary aliases, full function behavior and gameplay remain outside these bounded checks. Historical receipts and historical compiled-union artifacts stay immutable; current legacy tests bind the actual scoped records through exact source supersession. Unknown REP STOSD counts remain unknown in the effect tool. Native Kaya Guile additionally proves two omitted token writes: key_plus32 (flying) and color_forced34 (black/white), both now restored.
